meanings.en: calculated or judged approximately
meanings.exampleEn: The estimated cost of the project was two million dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Projenin tahmini maliyeti iki milyon dolardı.

meanings.en: forever; without end
meanings.exampleEn: She will be eternally grateful for his help.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun yardımı için sonsuza dek minnettar olacak.

meanings.en: a moral principle that governs behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: A strong work ethic is essential for success.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarı için güçlü bir çalışma ahlakı şarttır.

meanings.en: relating to a group with a common cultural tradition
meanings.exampleEn: The city is home to many ethnic communities.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir birçok etnik topluluğa ev sahipliği yapıyor.

meanings.en: to move people from a dangerous place to safety
meanings.exampleEn: Police had to evacuate the building after the bomb threat.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis, bomba tehdidinin ardından binayı tahliye etmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: the act of moving people away from danger
meanings.exampleEn: The evacuation of the village took several hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Köyün tahliyesi birkaç saat sürdü.

meanings.en: to judge the value or quality of something
meanings.exampleEn: Teachers evaluate students' progress at the end of each term.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenler her dönemin sonunda öğrencilerin ilerlemesini değerlendirir.

meanings.en: the process of judging the value of something
meanings.exampleEn: The evaluation of the new program showed positive results.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni programın değerlendirmesi olumlu sonuçlar gösterdi.

meanings.en: lasting forever or for a very long time
meanings.exampleEn: They promised each other everlasting love.
meanings.exampleTr: Birbirlerine sonsuz bir aşk sözü verdiler.

meanings.en: in a way that is clear or obvious
meanings.exampleEn: She was evidently upset by the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberden belli ki üzülmüştü.

meanings.en: morally bad or wicked
meanings.exampleEn: The story features an evil villain who terrorizes the town.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikâyede kasabayı terörize eden kötü bir kötü adam yer alıyor.

meanings.en: the gradual process of development or change
meanings.exampleEn: Darwin's theory of evolution changed how we view life.
meanings.exampleTr: Darwin'in evrim teorisi yaşamı görüşümüzü değiştirdi.

meanings.en: to develop gradually over time
meanings.exampleEn: Languages evolve constantly as people use them.
meanings.exampleTr: Diller, insanlar onları kullandıkça sürekli evrilir.

meanings.en: the quality of being precise and accurate
meanings.exampleEn: The exactness of his measurements impressed the engineers.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölçümlerinin kesinliği mühendisleri etkiledi.

meanings.en: to make something seem larger or more important than it is
meanings.exampleEn: Don't exaggerate; the fish wasn't that big.
meanings.exampleTr: Abartma; balık o kadar büyük değildi.

meanings.en: a statement that makes something seem more than it is
meanings.exampleEn: It is no exaggeration to say this was the best day of my life.
meanings.exampleTr: Bunun hayatımın en güzel günü olduğunu söylemek abartı değil.

meanings.en: to praise or honour someone highly
meanings.exampleEn: The poem exalts the courage of the soldiers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, askerlerin cesaretini yüceltir.

meanings.en: a person who takes an examination
meanings.exampleEn: Each examinee was given two hours to finish the test.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınava giren her adaya testi bitirmesi için iki saat verildi.

meanings.en: to be greater than a particular number or amount
meanings.exampleEn: Do not exceed the speed limit on this road.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yolda hız sınırını aşmayın.

meanings.en: to be very good at doing something
meanings.exampleEn: She continues to excel in mathematics.
meanings.exampleTr: Matematikte üstün olmaya devam ediyor.

meanings.en: something that is not included in a general rule
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone must follow the rules, with no exception.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes kurallara uymalı, istisnası yok.

meanings.en: unusually good or remarkable
meanings.exampleEn: She has an exceptional talent for painting.
meanings.exampleTr: Resim için olağanüstü bir yeteneği var.

meanings.en: to an unusually high degree
meanings.exampleEn: The weather was exceptionally warm for winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava, kış için olağanüstü derecede sıcaktı.

meanings.en: much more than is reasonable or necessary
meanings.exampleEn: Excessive drinking can damage your health.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşırı içki içmek sağlığınıza zarar verebilir.

meanings.en: to say something suddenly and loudly, often from emotion
meanings.exampleEn: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed.
meanings.exampleTr: "Ne güzel bir manzara!" diye haykırdı.

meanings.en: the punctuation mark (!) used to show strong feeling
meanings.exampleEn: He ended the sentence with an exclamation mark to show excitement.
meanings.exampleTr: Heyecanı göstermek için cümleyi bir ünlem işaretiyle bitirdi.

meanings.en: to deliberately keep someone or something out
meanings.exampleEn: The price does not exclude tax.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyat vergiyi hariç tutmaz.

meanings.en: the act of keeping someone or something out
meanings.exampleEn: The exclusion of certain groups from the meeting caused anger.
meanings.exampleTr: Belli grupların toplantıdan dışlanması öfkeye yol açtı.

meanings.en: only; not involving anyone or anything else
meanings.exampleEn: This offer is available exclusively to members.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu teklif yalnızca üyelere sunulmaktadır.

meanings.en: a short trip made for pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: We went on a day excursion to the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlara günübirlik bir geziye gittik.

meanings.en: the act of carrying out a plan or order
meanings.exampleEn: The execution of the plan required careful preparation.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın uygulanması dikkatli bir hazırlık gerektirdi.

meanings.en: the waste gases produced by an engine
meanings.exampleEn: The exhaust from the old bus filled the street with smoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski otobüsün egzozu sokağı dumanla doldurdu.

meanings.en: making you feel extremely tired
meanings.exampleEn: The long hike was absolutely exhausting.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüş kesinlikle yorucuydu.

meanings.en: the state of being extremely tired
meanings.exampleEn: She collapsed from exhaustion after the marathon.
meanings.exampleTr: Maratondan sonra bitkinlikten yere yığıldı.

meanings.en: to show something publicly or to display a quality
meanings.exampleEn: The museum will exhibit the paintings next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, tabloları gelecek ay sergileyecek.

meanings.en: the state of being forced to live away from one's country
meanings.exampleEn: The writer spent twenty years in exile.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazar yirmi yılını sürgünde geçirdi.

meanings.en: present or in use now
meanings.exampleEn: We need to improve the existing system before adding new features.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni özellikler eklemeden önce mevcut sistemi iyileştirmemiz gerekiyor.

meanings.en: unusual and exciting, often from a distant country
meanings.exampleEn: The market sold many exotic fruits from the tropics.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazar, tropik bölgelerden gelen birçok egzotik meyve satıyordu.

meanings.en: the process of becoming larger
meanings.exampleEn: The company's rapid expansion created many new jobs.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin hızlı genişlemesi birçok yeni iş yarattı.

meanings.en: a strong belief that something will happen
meanings.exampleEn: The film exceeded all my expectations.
meanings.exampleTr: Film tüm beklentilerimi aştı.

meanings.en: thought likely to happen or arrive
meanings.exampleEn: The expected results did not match what we found.
meanings.exampleTr: Beklenen sonuçlar bulduğumuzla örtüşmedi.

meanings.en: an organized journey with a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: They led an expedition to the South Pole.
meanings.exampleTr: Güney Kutbu'na bir keşif gezisine öncülük ettiler.

meanings.en: having great skill or knowledge in a subject
meanings.exampleEn: We received expert advice from a financial consultant.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir mali danışmandan uzman tavsiyesi aldık.

meanings.en: to burst suddenly with great force and noise
meanings.exampleEn: The bomb could explode at any moment.
meanings.exampleTr: Bomba her an patlayabilir.

meanings.en: to use someone or something unfairly for one's own benefit
meanings.exampleEn: Some companies exploit their workers by paying very low wages.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı şirketler çok düşük ücret ödeyerek işçilerini sömürür.

meanings.en: a person who travels to unknown places to discover them
meanings.exampleEn: The explorer mapped large parts of the Amazon.
meanings.exampleTr: Kâşif, Amazon'un büyük bölümlerinin haritasını çıkardı.

meanings.en: able or likely to explode
meanings.exampleEn: The workers handled the explosive material with great care.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler patlayıcı maddeyi büyük dikkatle taşıdılar.

meanings.en: clearly showing thoughts or feelings
meanings.exampleEn: She has a very expressive face that reveals her emotions.
meanings.exampleTr: Duygularını ele veren çok anlamlı bir yüzü var.

meanings.en: extremely beautiful and delicately made
meanings.exampleEn: The jeweller created an exquisite diamond ring.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuyumcu enfes bir pırlanta yüzük yaptı.

meanings.en: an additional period of time or an added part
meanings.exampleEn: She asked for an extension to finish her essay.
meanings.exampleTr: Denemesini bitirmek için ek süre istedi.

meanings.en: covering a large area or amount
meanings.exampleEn: The report required extensive research.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor geniş kapsamlı bir araştırma gerektirdi.

meanings.en: relating to the outside of something
meanings.exampleEn: The external walls of the house need painting.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin dış duvarlarının boyanması gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a short passage taken from a text, or a concentrated substance
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher read an extract from the novel.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen romandan bir alıntı okudu.

meanings.en: to a very unusual or remarkable degree
meanings.exampleEn: The cake was extraordinarily delicious.
meanings.exampleTr: Pasta olağanüstü derecede lezzetliydi.

meanings.en: very happy and triumphant, especially after success
meanings.exampleEn: The exultant fans celebrated their team's victory.
meanings.exampleTr: Sevinçten coşmuş taraftarlar takımlarının zaferini kutladı.

meanings.en: the line of hair above each eye
meanings.exampleEn: She raised an eyebrow in surprise.
meanings.exampleTr: Şaşkınlıkla bir kaşını kaldırdı.

meanings.en: one of the short hairs growing on the edge of the eyelid
meanings.exampleEn: An eyelash fell into her eye and made it water.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kirpik gözüne kaçtı ve gözünü sulandırdı.

meanings.en: the piece of skin that covers the eye when closed
meanings.exampleEn: His eyelids grew heavy as he became sleepy.
meanings.exampleTr: Uykusu gelince göz kapakları ağırlaştı.

meanings.en: cloth or material made by weaving threads
meanings.exampleEn: This dress is made from a soft cotton fabric.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu elbise yumuşak bir pamuklu kumaştan yapılmış.

meanings.en: extremely good or wonderful
meanings.exampleEn: We had a fabulous time at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partide harika vakit geçirdik.

meanings.en: buildings, equipment or services provided for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offers excellent sports facilities.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel mükemmel spor olanakları sunuyor.

meanings.en: one of the things that influences a result
meanings.exampleEn: Cost was an important factor in our decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Maliyet, kararımızda önemli bir etkendi.

meanings.en: a department in a university, or a natural mental ability
meanings.exampleEn: She studied law at the faculty of law.
meanings.exampleTr: Hukuk fakültesinde hukuk okudu.

meanings.en: strong belief or trust in someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She has great faith in her team's abilities.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımının yeteneklerine büyük inancı var.

meanings.en: to lose strength or confidence and become weak
meanings.exampleEn: His voice began to falter as he gave the speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmayı yaparken sesi duraksamaya başladı.

meanings.en: the state of being known by many people
meanings.exampleEn: The young singer rose to fame overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç şarkıcı bir gecede şöhrete kavuştu.

meanings.en: to make oneself or someone know something well
meanings.exampleEn: Please familiarize yourself with the safety rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen güvenlik kurallarına aşina olun.

meanings.en: extremely or remarkably
meanings.exampleEn: The plan worked out fantastically well.
meanings.exampleTr: Plan fevkalade iyi sonuçlandı.

meanings.en: extremely interested in something
meanings.exampleEn: The children were fascinated by the magician's tricks.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sihirbazın numaralarına hayran kalmıştı.

meanings.en: a strong attraction or interest in something
meanings.exampleEn: He has a lifelong fascination with space travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzay yolculuğuna karşı ömür boyu süren bir hayranlığı var.
